div.l: To kepe his forward by his free assent
He seide syn I shal begynne the game
What welcome be the cutte on goddes name
Now lat us ride and herkeneth what I sey
And with that word we riden forth oure wey
And he bigan with riȝt a mery chiere
His tale anon ⁊and seide as ye may here .

l.hi: hilom as olde stories tellen us

div.l: Ther was a Duc that hiȝt Theseus
Of Athenes he was lord ⁊and gouernoᵘur
And in his tyme such a conqueroᵘur
That gretter was ther non vnder the sonne
Full many a riche contre had he wonne
What with his wysdam ⁊and his chiualrye
He conquered the reigne of Femynye
That whilom was cleped Scithia
And wedded the quene ypolita
And brouȝt her hom with him in his contre
With mochel glory and gret solempnite
And eke here yong suster Emelie
And thus with victory and melodie
Lat I this noble duc to Athenes ride
And all his oost in armes him biside
And certes if it nere to long to here
I wolde haue told you fully the manere
Hou wunnen was the reigne of Femynye
By Theseus and by his chiualrye
And of the grete bataile for the nones
Betwix Athenes and Amazones
